e1_stmt: bias_correction2 must be identical across all subgroup invocations of the same optimizer step regardless of computation path.
e2_stmt: The bias-correction scaling applied to parameter updates must be identical across all subgroup invocations within the same optimizer step.

e1_stmt: The tensor size metadata must faithfully represent the true element count (no int32 overflow) so the update kernel executes.
e2_stmt: Parameters and optimizer state must change after an optimizer step with nonzero gradients, for tensors of any size including >= 2^31 elements.

e1_stmt: Recomputed activations under activation checkpointing must be identical to the original forward pass, so dropout masks match.
e2_stmt: Activations recomputed during activation-checkpoint backward must equal the original forward activations after the saved RNG state is restored.

e1_stmt: The overflow-guarded early return must trigger only when overflow is actually detected, so the step applies updates otherwise.
e2_stmt: The optimizer step must apply parameter updates whenever no gradient overflow is detected; it may skip only on overflow.

e1_stmt: The runtime sequence-parallel communication dtype must equal the user-configured seq_parallel_communication_data_type whenever that key is set.
e2_stmt: The dtype actually used for sequence-parallel communication must equal the user-configured seq_parallel_communication_data_type value.

e1_stmt: The checkpoint's optimizer-state layout must match the actually configured optimizer mode (no ZeRO-partitioned state when ZeRO is disabled) under bf16 training without ZeRO.
e2_stmt: Checkpoint save/load must classify the optimizer correctly (bf16 without ZeRO has no ZeRO partitioned state) so that reload restores exactly the state that was saved.

e1_stmt: The reduce-scatter input buffer must be cast to the configured communication_data_type exactly when it differs from the model dtype under ZeRO-3.
e2_stmt: The reduce-scatter communication buffer must be cast to the user-configured communication_data_type whenever it differs from the model dtype.

e1_stmt: Allreduced sparse gradients must be written back into the parameter's grad so no gradient contribution is dropped under DP>1.
e2_stmt: Post-allreduce sparse gradient values must be written back into the parameter's gradient consumed by the optimizer so sparse-embedding parameters are actually updated.

e1_stmt: The gate weight tensor used in the router forward must remain the same object registered with the distributed optimizer (no rebinding to a fresh copy) under ZeRO with fp16/bf16 downcast.
e2_stmt: The gate weight used in forward must be the same storage as the optimizer/ZeRO-managed parameter so that its gradients are reduced and its updates are applied across steps.

e1_stmt: Router gating weights must receive nonzero gradients through non-degenerate routing probabilities when top-k routing with k=1 uses post-topk softmax.
e2_stmt: Router gate parameters must receive nonzero gradients (routing probabilities must not be a constant 1.0) when num_experts >= 2, so the router actually learns.

e1_stmt: Gradients must be invariant to torch.compile being enabled (match the eager-mode reference) even when requires_grad switching triggers the recompile limit in RL-style loops.
e2_stmt: Gradients must propagate through the broadcast collective's registered autograd kernel (intact autograd graph) under guard: DP training with torch.compile inside a PPO loop.

e1_stmt: The learning rate applied at the first post-load step must equal the newly configured scheduler value (not the checkpoint value) under guard G = checkpoint resumed with --override-opt_param-scheduler.
e2_stmt: After checkpoint load with --override-opt_param-scheduler, the first-step learning rate must equal the newly configured schedule value, not the checkpoint's old value.

e1_stmt: The gradient buffer must be zeroed (finish_param_sync) before the first accumulation so initial parameter values do not pollute grads under guard G = reuse_grad_buf_for_mxfp8_param_ag with forward_pre_hook disabled.
e2_stmt: The gradient buffer must be zero-initialized before accumulation so main gradients equal only the summed micro-batch gradients, under guard: first iteration with forward_pre_hook disabled.

e1_stmt: The gradient buffer consumed by the optimizer must be the same buffer written by backward (decoupled_grad) under Megatron-FSDP with a fused optimizer.
e2_stmt: The optimizer must read gradients from the buffer where they are written (decoupled_grad), so parameter updates reflect the computed gradient, under guard: Megatron-FSDP + precision-aware FusedAdam.

e1_stmt: Expert parameter buffers used in forward must equal the optimizer's updated main parameters after parameter synchronization completes, even when the gather group size is 1.
e2_stmt: param_gather must mark dispatch/finish so expert parameters are refreshed to current values even when the intra distributed-optimizer instance size is 1.

e1_stmt: The CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay scheduler must produce LR values matching the specified warmup/decay schedule under guard G = scheduler initialization.
e2_stmt: The realized learning rate at each step must conform to the CosWithWarmupAndLinearDecay schedule from correct initialization.

e1_stmt: Compiled execution must produce the same results as eager execution when torch.compile is applied over FSDP set_ operations.
e2_stmt: torch.compile CSE must not eliminate expressions following an unfunctionalized set_, so the mutation's effect on FSDP results is preserved.

e1_stmt: Each step's observed gradient norm must be incorporated exactly once into the grad-norm EMA update (the EMA must not be updated from itself) whenever adaptive clipping is active.
e2_stmt: The grad-norm EMA update must combine the previous EMA and the current grad norm (ema = beta*ema_prev + (1-beta)*x), not update self-referentially.

e1_stmt: Attention outputs must remain finite (masked bias values must be representable in the compute dtype, e.g. finfo.min instead of -inf) under autocast mixed precision with padded/masked sequences.
e2_stmt: Masked-position bias must use finfo(target_dtype).min and be cast before the SDP call, so no -inf survives downcast to produce NaN under autocast.

e1_stmt: Reported cumulative Gflops must be proportional to the total number of tokens processed (accumulating monotonically across resumes) whenever speed monitoring is enabled.
e2_stmt: The cumulative FLOPs counter must accumulate per token and increase monotonically across steps and resumes, not be reset/overwritten each step.

e1_stmt: The runtime device placement and distributed mode must match the actually available/requested backend (CUDA hosts must not be silently rewritten to MPS/CPU with distributed disabled) at startup.
e2_stmt: The device-selection guard must evaluate the real predicate (torch.backends.mps.is_available()), so the chosen device matches available hardware instead of always resolving to MPS.

e1_stmt: The readout (output projection) weights must be initialized to zero, per the muP prescription, when use_mup is enabled.
e2_stmt: The output readout weights must retain the muP zero initialization so that the model's output scale at init is invariant across model widths when use_mup is enabled.

e1_stmt: The muP attention scale must equal sqrt(base_d)/d, matching the standard-parameterization scale 1/sqrt(d) exactly at the base width, whenever use_mup is enabled on the SDP path.
e2_stmt: The attention temperature under muP must equal the standard-parameterization value 1/sqrt(d) whenever the head count equals the muP base width, and track muP scaling rules otherwise.

e1_stmt: The readout (MuReadout) weights must retain the muP prescribed zero/special init and not be overwritten by generic truncated-normal init under guard: use_mup enabled.
e2_stmt: Weights constructed as muP readout modules must retain the muP-prescribed zero/special initialization so activation magnitudes remain width-invariant when use_mup is enabled.

e1_stmt: The FFN output must equal the reference gated computation silu(w1(h)) * w3(h) under guard that a SwiGLU-style gated FFN is configured.
e2_stmt: The gated-FFN output must include the multiplicative gate branch, i.e. both projections must contribute to the computed output when a SwiGLU FFN is configured.

e1_stmt: The learning rate at each training progress point must follow the configured sqrt-decay functional form 1-sqrt(1-progress) under guard that the sqrt decay scheduler is selected.
e2_stmt: During the decay phase the learning-rate multiplier must decrease with training progress following the intended 1-sqrt(1-progress) curve shape.

e1_stmt: Each rank's contribution to the globally reduced loss must be proportional to its count of kept (unmasked) tokens under guard that per-rank sum-then-allreduce averaging is used.
e2_stmt: The global loss must equal the sum of per-token losses divided by the global count of loss-contributing tokens across the data-parallel group, even when some ranks mask out instances.

e1_stmt: The sliding-window mask value at each (query,key) pair must equal the logical AND of both one-sided window conditions under guard that a two-sided sliding window is configured.
e2_stmt: Attended key positions must be bounded within the configured two-sided window around each query position when sliding-window attention is enabled.
